capability.instruction: Score how true this is in practice today. Use evidence and consistency, not intent.

options.label: Not in place
options.meaning: This is not true in practice yet, or we do not really do it.

options.label: Inconsistent
options.meaning: It happens in some cases, but not reliably, consistently or with clear evidence.

options.label: Partly in place
options.meaning: We have a working version, but usage, ownership or evidence is uneven.

options.label: Consistent
options.meaning: It is part of how we normally operate and we can evidence it.

options.label: Proven and improving
options.meaning: It works, is evidenced, and we review or improve it over time.

options.label: Well below target
options.meaning: This area is materially short of where it needs to be.

options.label: Below target
options.meaning: There is some movement, but it is not enough or not reliable.

options.label: Partly on track
options.meaning: There is usable movement, but it is uneven or not yet enough.

options.label: On track
options.meaning: This area is broadly where it needs to be.

options.label: Strong
options.meaning: This area is ahead of target or clearly working.
